stories.headline: The United States take a 12th women's basketball world title
stories.summary: The United States beat France 97–79 in the final of the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup in Berlin. It was their 12th title in the competition. The tournament was hosted in Berlin, Germany, from 4 to 13 September 2026.

stories.headline: A Golden Lion at Venice for Woman Unknown
stories.summary: The 83rd Venice International Film Festival has closed at Venice Lido in Italy. Its top prize, the Golden Lion, went to Woman Unknown by May el-Toukhy. The festival ran from 2 to 12 September 2026.

stories.headline: The Olympic flame reaches Senegal ahead of the Youth Games
stories.summary: The Olympic flame has arrived in Dakar, Senegal, ahead of the Summer Youth Olympic Games. The Games will be the first International Olympic Committee event held in Africa. They run for 14 days, from 31 October to 13 November 2026.

stories.headline: The American cheetah turns out not to be a cheetah
stories.summary: Ancient DNA from four fossils found in Wyoming and the Yukon Territory in Canada has changed what scientists think about an extinct cat. The animal long called the American cheetah was more closely related to the modern puma, also called the mountain lion or cougar, than to today's cheetahs.
